description: Fill the area inside a path on the active layer with a colour (Paths panel > Fill Path), with blend mode, opacity, feather and anti-aliasing. Give a path from the Paths panel or points for a temporary one

color.description: "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)". Default the foreground colour

path.description: Name of a path in the Paths panel

points.description: Instead of path: corners of a temporary path, [[x, y], ...] in pixels. It is removed afterwards

name: fill_path
title: Fill Path
